data_description.ring_until_acknowledged: The timer stays "ringing" after it runs out, until it is acknowledged. Off: it is gone right after the finished event; timers ringing when you turn it off are acknowledged.
data_description.reminder_minutes: While a timer rings, a reminder event every so many minutes. 0: no reminders.
data_description.auto_dismiss_minutes: A ringing timer is acknowledged by itself after so many minutes (for a timer missed during a restart: counted from the start). 0: it rings until acknowledged.
data_description.report_missed: A timer that ran out while Home Assistant was restarting is reported right after the start (finished event with "late"). Off: it is dropped.

start.name: Start
start.description: Starts a timer: on a station (target: its device or entities; replaces its timer) or in an area (target: the area or its Home Timer device), from a preset or with a name and a duration.

name.name: Name
name.description: What the timer is for, e.g. "Let dough rest". With a duration, instead of a preset.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the timer runs. With a name, instead of a preset.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional text that goes with the timer's events, e.g. for the notification. With a preset: instead of the preset's note.

source.name: Source
source.description: Optional data of the caller (a script, another integration); returned in every event of the timer.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: A preset of the targeted station, or a quick timer of the targeted area (its name). Instead of a name and a duration.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

add_time.name: Add time
add_time.description: Adds time to a timer. A ringing timer starts again with the added time.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

subtract_time.name: Subtract time
subtract_time.description: Takes time off a timer. Down to zero, it runs out.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How much time to take off.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Cancels a timer, whatever its state.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Acknowledges a ringing timer, or all ringing timers of the targeted areas.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

assign.name: Assign to a station
assign.description: Attaches a timer to a station (target: its device or entities) of the same area. It keeps its state and time; a timer the station has is replaced.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer to attach, e.g. one started without a station.
